excursions.name: Fanja Tanikely & Sakatia
excursions.description:
8h00 Departure from Komba Cabana beach

8h30 -11h00 Nosy Tanikely - snorkeling, free time, visit of the island and its lighthouse.

11h30-13h00 Nosy Sakatia - snorkeling with the giant turtles.

13h00 Lunch of local specialities on the beach.

14h00-15h00 Visit of Nosy Sakatia, free time.

16h30 Arrival at Komba Cabana Beach

Nosy Tanikely :
Real open air aquarium.
With a mask and a snorkel, you will easily come across turtles, rays, groupers, triggerfish and other tropical fishes. On the island, our guide will also take you to discover the terrestrial biodiversity: lizards, lemurs, bats... A magnificent panoramic view of the bay of Nosy Be awaits you from the lighthouse.

Nosy Sakatia :
The green turtle sanctuary.
At the bottom of the sacred forest you can observe green sea turtles. An herbarium well protected from the waves, favors the presence of the giant turtles which come to feed in peace. With a mask and a snorkel we will go to meet them.

Lunch will be held a few meters from the beach, in the shade of palm trees, you will taste local specialties while enjoying the ocean view.

12:30 PM Arrival at Nosy Sakatia island and lunch on the beach.
2:00 PM - 2:30 PM Snorkeling with giant green sea turtles and island tour.
3:00 PM Return trip.
